chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Yūnus, from Ibrāhīm al-Khazzāz Abī Ayyūb, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:

I asked him about a man who had been unconscious for several days and did not perform salat (prayer), then regained consciousness: should he perform the missed prayers? He said: There is nothing upon him.

key_terms.أُغْمِيَ: became unconscious or was overtaken by unconsciousness

ai.seo_question: Does a person who was unconscious for several days have to make up missed salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a person who loses consciousness for several days and misses salat (prayer) during that period. Imam Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام states that no makeup of those missed prayers is required from him after regaining consciousness.
